findings.evidence: Local convention names the RHS after `_eq`: `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/OrderedSimplexIntegral.lean:329 setIntegral_orderedRegion_eq_orderedProdIntegral`, `:344 setIntegral_orderedRegion_eq_pow_div_factorial`, and `PDF/ChargeConjugation.lean:162 valenceNumber_eq_sub_valenceTarget`.
findings.issue: `setIntegral_unitTriangle_mul_sub_eq` (line 125) and `sum_setIntegral_unitTriangle_eq` (line 143) end in a dangling `_eq` that names no right-hand side, and `mul_sub` does not say the weight is the second coordinate. Both are public API.

findings.fix: Name the hypothesis that singles it out, e.g. `valenceNumber_eq_of_sum_mellinMoment_one_eq_one`, mirroring its companion `sum_mellinMoment_one_eq_one`.
findings.issue: `valenceNumber_eq` proves `valenceNumber f i Q2 = N i` but names neither the RHS nor the distinguishing hypothesis, while the file does `open PDF`, bringing the `valenceNumber_eq_sub_valenceTarget` / `valenceNumber_eq_zero_of_*` family into the same scope.

findings.evidence: DoubleParton/PocketFormula.lean:140 `orderedDPSIntegral_comm` (hypothesis `∀ p₁ p₂ y, F p₂ p₁ y = F p₁ p₂ y`, docstring "symmetric under exchange of their two partons"), :125 `dpsCrossSection_comm`; vs UnitTriangle.lean:74 `swap_mem_unitTriangle`, :132 `setIntegral_unitTriangle_comp_swap`, both about `Prod.swap`.
findings.issue: `threeQuarkDpd_swap` states exchange of the two partons (`F b a x₂ x₁ = F a b x₁ x₂`), which the same `DoubleParton` namespace already calls `_comm`; meanwhile `swap` in this PR consistently means `Prod.swap`, so the name is doubly loaded.

findings.evidence: OrderedSimplexIntegral.lean:256 `integrableOn_orderedRegion` and :432 `integrableOn_descendingRegion` both have the named set as the `IntegrableOn` domain.
findings.issue: `integrableOn_integral_unitTriangle` concludes `IntegrableOn (fun y => ∫ x in Icc 0 (1 - y), g (x, y)) (Icc 0 1)` — integrability on `[0,1]`, not on the triangle — but in this repo `integrableOn_<set>` names the domain of integration.

summary: Four names do not describe their conclusions in the conventions this repo already uses: two public step lemmas end in a bare `_eq` naming only the left-hand side, `valenceNumber_eq` breaks the existing `valenceNumber_eq_*` pattern, `threeQuarkDpd_swap` uses `swap` where the same namespace names parton exchange `_comm`, and `integrableOn_integral_unitTriangle` names a domain it does not integrate over.
